name: M5.Binomial.negative_coeff
statement: ∀ m j : ℕ, (((1 : Polynomial ℤ) - Polynomial.X) ^ m).coeff j = (-1 : ℤ) ^ j * (m.choose j : ℤ)
guidance: Expand (1-X)^m with add_pow after rewriting 1-X=(-X)+1. Like Polynomial.coeff_X_add_C_pow, apply coeff_sum and use (-X)^i=(-1)^i*X^i; only index j contributes. Handle j>m using choose_eq_zero_of_lt. An induction with binomial recursion is also valid. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve exact target.
